simple.summary: בַּת־שׁוּעַ (Bath-Shûwaʻ) means Bath-shua , First listed occurrence: 1Chr 3 5.

definitions.full: H1340. Bath -shua בַּתשֿׁוּעַ proper name, feminine (?) ( daughter of opulence ?) — 1 wife of David, mother of Solomon , etc. 1Chr 3:5 = בַּתשֶֿׁ֫בַּע q. v.; We Klo בַּתשֶֿׁ֫וַע compare Be; but probably textual error. see Dr on 2Sam 11:3 . 2 wife of Judah 1Chr 2:3 ׳שֿׁ׳ב הַכְּנַעֲנִית , RV Bathshua but in || Gen 38:2 , 12 not a proper name (compare V:2).
definitions.rootNote: from 1323 and 7771 ; daughter of wealth; the same as 1339
